question.worked_solution:
First, we note that $(f∘f)(x)$ is equivalent to $f(f(x)).$

To find $f(f(x)),$ we write down the function $f$ and replace every occurrence of $x$ with $f(x):$

$$
\begin{aligned}f(x) & =2{x}^{2}-1 \\ f(f(x)) & =2(f(x))^{2}-1\end{aligned}
$$

Then, we substitute $f(x)=2{x}^{2}-1$ into the right-hand side of the above and simplify, as follows:

$$
\begin{aligned}f(f(x)) & =2(f(x))^{2}-1 \\  & =2(2{x}^{2}-1)^{2}-1 \\  & =2(4{x}^{4}-4{x}^{2}+1)-1 \\  & =8{x}^{4}-8{x}^{2}+1\end{aligned}
$$

Therefore, $(f∘f)(x)=8{x}^{4}-8{x}^{2}+1.$
